features.description: Backs the workflow runtime persistence seams with Groundwork over SQLite. Durable storage keeps checkpoints, post-commit outbox items and queued scheduler work across a crash; compose alongside Workflows Runtime Resumption so a background pump re-drives that work after a restart.

options.description: Maximum number of tenant, scope, and privilege bindings retained by this shell. Old bindings are evicted safely when the bounded cache is full.
options.name: AccessBoundStoreCacheCapacity

options.description: When enabled, safe pending schema operations are applied automatically at startup instead of requiring Groundwork.Tool. Destructive operations are never auto-applied.
options.name: AutoApplySchemaOnStartup

options.description: Retain a bounded shell-local cache of immutable workflow executable artifacts loaded from durable storage, isolated by persistence scope.
options.name: CacheWorkflowExecutables

options.description: SQLite connection string used by the Groundwork runtime document store.
options.name: ConnectionString

options.description: Reuse immutable, access-bound Groundwork store adapters while each operation continues to own an independent SQLite connection. Enabled by default.
options.name: ReuseAccessBoundStores

options.description: When enabled, startup records an applied-plan fingerprint and skips the full schema inspection/validation walk on later boots whose composed plan is unchanged, cutting warm-boot admission from a full re-validation to a single fingerprint read. Off by default: the fingerprint proves the plan is current but cannot detect schema changed out-of-band while the host was down. Leave disabled to keep per-boot drift re-validation.
options.displayName: Skip schema inspection when the plan is unchanged
options.name: SkipSchemaInspectionWhenPlanUnchanged

options.description: Maximum number of immutable workflow executable artifacts retained by this shell. Must be positive when caching is enabled.
options.name: WorkflowExecutableCacheCapacity
